## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop`, and targets `develop` — never `main`
- [ ] Commit subjects follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/); versions are derived from them
- [ ] `vibey-gh check` passes — every commit trailered, every source file stamped
- [ ] This repository's own gates pass locally (see its `CONTRIBUTING.md`); a declared coverage floor is a floor, not a target
- [ ] No gate bypassed (`--no-verify`, admin merge) and no managed file edited by hand — anything marked *Generated by vibey-gh* is rendered from a template
- [ ] Agent-surface trees (`.claude/`, `.agents/`, `.cursor/`, `.agent/`) updated together if guidance changed
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] I agree to the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/the-vibey-project/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and to license this contribution under the MIT License
